items.hook: Founded in 1895, Brooklawn became one of the earliest members of the United States Golf Association (USGA) when it was admitted on January 22, 1896.
items.body: Brooklawn Country Club is a private country club in Fairfield, Connecticut. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Caves of Steel is a science fiction novel by American writer Isaac Asimov.
items.body: It is a detective story and illustrates an idea Asimov advocated, that science fiction can be applied to any literary genre, rather than just being a limited genre in itself. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Vagrants is the first novel by Yiyun Li.
items.body: It was published in 2009, following her award-winning 2005 short story collection A Thousand Years of Good Prayers. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Day of the Triffids is a 1963 British apocalyptic science-fiction horror film directed by Steve Sekely, loosely based on John Wyndham's 1951 novel of the same name.
items.body: It stars Howard Keel, Nicole Maurey, Janette Scott, Kieron Moore and Mervyn Johns. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Dark Magic is the fourth book in Christine Feehan's Dark Series.
items.body: It takes place within a few months of the events in Dark Gold. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Poor Musician is an 1847 novella by the Austrian writer Franz Grillparzer.
items.body: Set in a Vienna suburb, it is about the encounter between the narrator, who is a worldly successful and open-minded dramatist, and the old street musician Jakob, whose career and love life have been failures. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.
